node.title: Re^3: GLOB function (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Use of uninitialized value $arg in stat at /user/s5e7420/local/lib/perl5/5.18.0/File/stat.pm line 206.

It [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/a9acda3b5f74585852a57b51b724804ac586cb0b:/lib/File/stat.pm#l204|looks like] you're passing undef to stat, but I'm not aware of a situation where [doc://glob] (Update: in list context) might return undef. Could you show the minimal code needed to reproduce this error? ([id://1177642], [id://174051], and [id://510718])
